title: Global well-posedness for nonlinear generalized Camassa-Holm equation
summary: We establish local and global well-posedness for the Cauchy problem of a generalized Camassa-Holm equation where orders of the momentum and the nonlinearity can be arbitrarily high. More precisely, we consider the equation \begin{equation*} m_t + m_x u^p + b m u^{p-1}u_x = -(g(u))_x + (b+1)u^p u_x, \quad m = (1-\partial_x^2)^k u, \end{equation*} where $p \geq 1$, $k \geq 1$ are arbitrary, $b$ is a real parameter, and $g(u)$ is a smooth function. %The standard Camassa-Holm equation corresponds to $k=1$, $p=1$, $b=2$, and $g(u)=0$.
